tasks.name: Convex platform reactivation
tasks.description: Upgrade or reactivate the shared Convex team after the database-I/O quota suspension, disable the root-page uptime probe, and establish enough I/O headroom for one bounded rebuild.
tasks.acceptance: Production deploys and zero-read servicePing calls succeed; the monitor no longer requests `/`; quota/billing state is active.

tasks.name: Exact-SHA verification
tasks.description: Pin one SHA contained in the production branch and run the static Convex query-efficiency guardrail, focused public-discovery checks, full test suite, application checks, and Convex type checks.
tasks.acceptance: Every verification command passes for the exact SHA recorded as the deploy input.

tasks.name: Deploy snapshot-safe Convex producer
tasks.description: From the clean verified SHA, preview and deploy the Convex schema/functions to quirky-chinchilla-352 before approving any frontend deployment.
tasks.acceptance: Convex dry-run and deploy succeed; publicDiscoveryList and publicDiscoveryRelations resolve through bounded versioned snapshot reads.

tasks.name: Rebuild and prove snapshot readiness
tasks.description: Run the composite homepage snapshot rebuild and verify the public manifest reports both list and relations ready at nonzero revisions.
tasks.acceptance: For an existing publication, a pre-rebuild recovery point is recorded; list sourceCap is 250, relation sourceCap is 50, expected corpus counts are nonzero, every snapshot is below 900000 bytes, and both manifest families are ready.

tasks.name: Backend read-path smoke
tasks.description: Call the manifest and versioned public-discovery payload queries directly, then inspect Convex logs/usage for singleton snapshot reads rather than templates-corpus scans.
tasks.acceptance: Each one-read payload revision equals its corresponding ready manifest revision, content is populated as expected, no vectors are returned, and request reads do not grow with the embedding-bearing corpus.

tasks.name: Approve and deploy frontend consumer
tasks.description: Approve the protected GitHub production Environment only after PD-30 and PD-40, then deploy the same verified SHA to Cloudflare Pages.
tasks.acceptance: The immutable Pages deployment for the exact SHA passes `/api/health` before custom-origin traffic is warmed.

tasks.name: Invalidate and warm edge generations
tasks.description: Let materialization revisions replace the origin-scoped Cache API + PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_KV envelopes; use the production purge as defense in depth and warm list, graph, and API paths at the custom origin.
tasks.acceptance: The custom origin serves the new generation without a cold-start empty payload or one Convex payload refresh per Cloudflare location.

tasks.name: Live smoke and observation
tasks.description: Verify list, graph, API cache headers, zero-read health, and post-warm Convex I/O, then move the uptime monitor to `/api/health`.
tasks.acceptance: Public paths render, health returns 200/ok, only snapshot tables appear in public-query reads, and database I/O stays flat relative to page requests.

tasks.name: Roll back Pages only
tasks.description: Restore the prior immutable Pages deployment while leaving the snapshot-safe Convex backend in place.
tasks.acceptance: The previous frontend is healthy and still consumes bounded snapshot queries.

tasks.name: Repair snapshot and cache generation
tasks.description: Correct source/code, rerun the atomic rebuild, then refresh the revision-aware cache payload; use a schema-version bump only when an urgent explicit namespace cutover is needed.
tasks.acceptance: A corrected ready revision is published and warmed without deleting the last-known-good payload first.

tasks.name: Forward-deploy known snapshot-safe backend
tasks.description: Redeploy known-good bounded-read Convex code and rebuild. Never restore a version where public requests collect embedding-bearing templates.
tasks.acceptance: All public discovery functions retain indexed/capped snapshot reads; data restore is handled separately if a logically bad successful rebuild replaced a singleton.
